info.title: Megadex — user profile, preferences and reference data
info.description:
Megadex API, reached through Gatelin (Traefik `/api` → Gatelin → megadex), which authenticates the caller and injects the `x-consumer-*` headers.

**How to try it.** Call `POST /gatelin/sessions` with a dev user, then click **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken`.

**Dev credentials.** The `__EMAIL_<userId>__` / `__PWD_<userId>__` placeholders are replaced by `scripts/setup-mocks.sh` after it seeds the dev users' passwords in Foxnox. If you still see literal placeholders, run `scripts/setup-mocks.sh`.

searchRequest.description: Common body for every `POST /<entity>/search` route. All fields optional. `filters` is a per-column map: `{ <column>: { value, matchMode } }`.

pagination.description: When true, the response includes `total` = matching row count (before pagination)

filters.description: Map of column name to filter clause. See `antity-pgsql` for the full matchMode grammar.

historyEntry.description: Grouped `log.history` rows for one action (see src/middlewares/history.js).

record.description: JSON snapshot of the affected row

entityProperty.description: One row of the metadata returned by `GET /<entity>/schema`. Private properties are filtered out at that endpoint.

badRequestError.description: Missing or invalid parameters in body / path / query

unauthorizedError.description: Password mismatch or missing/invalid access token
